descriptor: Bill splitter for dinners with friends

voice.summary: Tabsplit talks like the friend who is good with money and never makes it awkward. It is light, specific about who owes what, and always rounds in everyone's favour to the exact cent.
dos: Name the person and the amount together
Show the maths in one short line
donts: Do not shame anyone for what they ordered
Do not leave a missing cent unexplained

taglines: Everyone pays their share, to the cent
Tap the dish, skip the spreadsheet
Splitting the bill without splitting friends
boilerplate: Tabsplit is an itemised bill splitter that shares dishes, tax and tip fairly between friends and shows exactly who owes whom.

microcopy.success: Settled. Odette gets back 14.20 and nobody is out of pocket.
microcopy.error: The shares do not add up to the total yet. Check the last dish.
microcopy.empty: No dishes yet. Add the first line from the receipt.

logo.note: Coins say money without the stiffness of a bank, and they split nicely.
